title: update_app_settings applies earlier fields before a later field's validation fails
outcome: Pre-existing, surfaced by the Kimi parity review (Codex /review-code, 2026-09-26). session_crud.rs update_app_settings mutates inner.preferences field by field under the lock; set_agent_default_model_if_present (e.g. an invalid Claude default model starting with '-', or an OpenCode model that fails normalize_opencode_model) and the 'cannot remove remote ... still used by project' check return 400 after earlier fields of the same request were already written to memory. The revision/publication are skipped, but the in-memory preferences keep the partial change and later create_session calls inherit it; it is persisted by the next unrelated commit. The Kimi effort instance was fixed in the parity change (validated before the lock). Fix: validate every field before the lock, or build a candidate AppPreferences clone and swap it in only on success; test a mixed valid+invalid request leaves preferences and revision unchanged.
acceptance: An app settings request that mixes valid changes with either an invalid agent default or removal of a remote used by a project returns 400, leaves effective and persisted preferences and the state revision unchanged, and publishes no settings update. A valid mixed-field request still applies its settings together. Behavior tests cover both rejection paths and a successful update.

completion.summary: Landed with Batch 6. App settings requests validate a copy of the preferences before applying changes. An invalid agent default or removal of a remote still in use returns 400 without leaking other settings. The two rejection regressions and successful mixed update passed in the exact 97/97 Central run (verification 6a5ecf997305460998b977a8a6945815). Both reviews cover the identical contribution; Batch 6 passed Linux test-c500875d and Windows test-3a63f1f5 and has fresh independent acceptance 9b2f4c28b5d7410988fa8960e5b357cd. Opus2 recorded landing at 08:00:47Z and authorized completion in mailbox #1740, with Batch 6 installation to follow.
